## JobPilot Daily Agent

Runs every day at **8:00 AM Asia/Riyadh**.

1. Loads config + processed job history
2. Fetches from Adzuna, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, RSS
3. Filters Saudi + Remote, dedupes, last 7 days
4. Scores each job vs master resume (AI)
5. Score ≥ 70 → tailored resume + cover letter PDF
6. Score < 70 → saved as Low Match
7. Sends one daily email (sorted by score)
8. Saves all jobs to Google Sheets

Set `AUTO_APPLY_ENABLED=true` to route qualified jobs to Auto Apply sub-workflow.
